title: Malicious code in cygnus-contract (npm)
description: The cygnus-contract npm package contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. It can lead to complete system takeover, necessitating immediate rotation of all secrets and keys from a different, uncompromised machine. Removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious components due to potential persistent backdoors or additional malware installed.
